_meta.description: PCN cross-backbone sanity check, per-seed Overall metrics on the official PCN test split (1,200 samples across 8 categories; proxy difficulty bins computed once from the training distribution).

metrics.CD-L1: Chamfer L1 distance, scaled by 1e3 (lower is better)
metrics.CD-L2: Chamfer L2 distance, scaled by 1e3 (lower is better)

_meta.training: 30-epoch fine-tune from a shared UpTrans pretrained checkpoint; same crop pipeline and optimiser across vanilla and DiffCond
_meta.delta_convention: DiffCond minus Vanilla-FT (sign-aware: positive = DiffCond improvement; CD lower is better, F-Score higher is better)
_meta.purpose: Bounded second-benchmark sanity check of the UpTrans-native DiffCond (main paper Sec. 5.5); PCN has no native S/M/H bins so we use the proxy difficulty in data/PCN/difficulty_proxy.json.

delta_pct._note: Computed from full-precision per-seed values; back-computation from the rounded mean entries above will differ slightly (cf. main paper Table 2 and supplementary Table 11 captions). All three deltas are well below the +3% method-bar.
